mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, qt.Qst_Name as qstName, qt.Qst_Code as qstCode, qt.Qst_Item as qstItem, c1.C_Name as qsrCname, c2.C_Name as qsrFzCname, u1.U_Name as qsrXdUname, mn.* from Qs_Record mn left join Qs_Type qt on qt.Qst_Id=mn.Qst_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Qsr_Cid left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Qsr_Fz_Cid left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Qsr_Xd_Uid left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Qsr_Id where mn.Qsr_Id=#{qsrId}

select pro.P_Id as pId, pro.P_Name as pName, responsibleUnit.C_Name as responsibleUnitName, case when mn.Qsr_Category = 1 then '安全问题' else '质量问题' end as problemCategory, count(mn.Qsr_Id) as problemCount, sum(case when mn.Qsr_State = 7 then 1 else 0 end) as rectifiedCount, case when count(mn.Qsr_Id) = 0 then 0 else sum(case when mn.Qsr_State = 7 then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(mn.Qsr_Id) end as rectificationRate from Qs_Record mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sys_User rectifyUser on rectifyUser.U_Id = mn.Qsr_Rectify_Uid left join SYS_Company responsibleUnit on responsibleUnit.C_Id = rectifyUser.C_Id ${params.authSql} and pro.P_Id is not null and mn.Qsr_Category in (0, 1)
and mn.Te_Id = #{params.teId}
and pro.P_Id = #{params.pId}
and likePname(#{params.pName}, pro.P_Id) = true
and pro.P_Name like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and mn.Qsr_Category = #{params.qsrCategory}
and responsibleUnit.C_Id = #{params.responsibleUnitId}
and mn.qsr_State = #{params.qsrState}
and likeCname(#{params.responsibleUnitName}, responsibleUnit.C_Id) = true
and responsibleUnit.c_Name like concat('%',#{params.responsibleUnitName},'%')
group by pro.P_Id, pro.P_Name, responsibleUnit.C_Id, responsibleUnit.C_Name, mn.Qsr_Category
order by pro.P_Name ${params.sortType}, max(mn.Qsr_Create_Time) DESC
order by responsibleUnit.C_Name ${params.sortType}, max(mn.Qsr_Create_Time) DESC
order by problemCount ${params.sortType}, max(mn.Qsr_Create_Time) DESC
order by rectifiedCount ${params.sortType}, max(mn.Qsr_Create_Time) DESC
order by rectificationRate ${params.sortType}, max(mn.Qsr_Create_Time) DESC
order by max(mn.Qsr_Create_Time) DESC, pro.P_Name ASC, responsibleUnit.C_Name ASC, mn.Qsr_Category ASC

select (select count(1) from Qs_Record where qsr_Category = 1) securityTotalNum , (select count(1) from Qs_Record where qsr_State = 7 and qsr_Category = 1) safetyProblemNum, (select count(1) from Qs_Record where qsr_Category = 0) qualityTotalNum, (select count(1) from Qs_Record where qsr_State = 7 and qsr_Category = 0) qualitySafetyNum, '1' type from Qs_Record limit 1;
